llm.summary: This skill appears to be a broad Ollama integration guide, but its local-only framing conflicts with API key and network guidance while requesting read, write, and command execution authority.

dimensions.detail: Local Ollama use can justify some command execution and localhost API interaction, but the artifact does not clearly separate local-only operation from remote/API-key/network behavior or describe data flow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only a SKILL.md with no executable install hook or bundled script, but the front matter declares read, exec, and write tools.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation guidance covers general model calls, conversations, agent orchestration, and LLM applications, which is broader than explicit Ollama use and could invoke the skill in unrelated contexts.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, privilege escalation, destructive action, or credential storage mechanism is present; the main privilege concern is the broad read/exec/write declaration and generic API_KEY guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is local Ollama model integration, but the artifact also describes generic API integration, API key setup, network security, automatic workflows, and broad AI/agent use cases without clear boundaries.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this only if you intentionally want an agent to run local Ollama-related commands and possibly manage files. Do not provide real API keys unless the publisher clarifies what service receives them, what endpoints are contacted, and when prompts or files leave the machine.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported by the artifact: it frames the skill as local Ollama integration while also requiring an API key and discussing API-style operation without explaining whether any external endpoint is used.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported by the artifact: it says local operation is a boundary but also includes API key leakage and HTTPS/network-security guidance, leaving the trust model unclear.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Supported by the artifact: the trigger language is much broader than Ollama-specific tasks and includes general AI conversation and agent orchestration.
